name: veoflow
description: Intelligent context-aware voice dictation desktop assistant

scripts.start: node -e "delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const cp = require('child_process').spawn(require('electron'), ['.'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); cp.on('exit', code => process.exit(code || 0));"
scripts.dev: node -e "delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const cp = require('child_process').spawn(require('electron'), ['.'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); cp.on('exit', code => process.exit(code || 0));"
scripts.build:package: npm run build:helper && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build:dir: npm run build:helper && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
scripts.build:portable: npm run build:helper && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win portable --x64

author: VeoFlow
